fact: La Nouvelle Tribune reports on 25 August 2026 that the reform of the national statistical system, bills 046.26 and 047.26 adopted by the Government Council on 2 July 2026 and validated by both chambers, has entered into force, and that the president of the new Conseil national de l'information statistique has up to 24 months to set up its structures.
title: Statistiques: le HCP devient instance de bonne gouvernance, un conseil nommé par dahir fixera les normes
